notes.title: New! Co-op Story Mode Added!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981051/a8cd6a478c9b2f99219c750ac586bfc913b56e8e.png[/img]

Hello! This is Ikerandal.
Today is two new for you!

[h2]1.Co-op Story Mode[/h2]
It has coming!
Two people can do business together.
Please select 2P Co-op Mode!

[h2]2.Added Stage[/h2]
In Story Mode, I Added some new stages.
Please challenge and clear these stages!

Have fun!!
From Japan with love.

notes.title: Add the stages and You can choice the stage!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981051/cfdc16d0be4a7724cd23edbd54c178bcc5bce2a5.png[/img]
Hi everyone!

[h2]I added the new stage in story mode.[/h2]
Please enjoy new stages!

You can choice the stage that cleared.
If there is the stage you like, anytime play it.
 
see you next update!

notes.title: More Active and Exciting!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981051/f1bf7cac7fe55d5ad4df56d376e56acd3f4720b5.png[/img]

It's taken quite a while, and I'm really sorry!ːsteamthisː
Instead, this version 0.8 is an update that will bring significant changes to the way you play!

[h2]big changes[/h2]
[olist]
[b]Characters are powered up![/b] : Now you can perform magic while moving!
[b]Treasure Chest Increase Festival![/b] : Our clients will be motivated and will give you a lot of work!
[/olist]

[h2]Future plans[/h2]
 [u]New levels added to story mode[/u]

This update will likely be the last update for early access.

[h2]Unfortunate news[/h2]
  It has become clear that the ranking and achievement features are beyond my ability for the time being...
  Please forgive me!!


Thank you for playing!!

notes.title: OurLoadMap
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981051/69f52ccd827328305a0e8d18fdc94dae9622d850.png[/img]
Hello! Everyone!!
June has coming!

今後のリリースまでの計画と課題をお知らせいたします。We would like to inform you of our plans and challenges for future releases.

[h3]Planned remodeling[/h3]
　[u]Completion of story mode[/u]
　　We will continue to create the final version, including the length and difficulty of the mode!　

　[u]Endressモードの調整[/u]
　　How does Takeru-Kun work? This is up to your opinion.

[h3]Under research[/h3]
　With my skills, I realized that I needed to do more research before modifying it.
　It is unclear whether it will be possible to implement it during early access, but we will continue to research it
　
　Implementation of achievements function
　Implementation of ranking

We are also collecting opinions on the bulletin board, so please let us know!

notes.title: Weekly Development Report
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44981051/bca17b6c6c6aa0b907cf862721ecbfb445170bb8.png[/img]

Hello World!! This is Ikerandal.
I report the development of last week.

1.Keyboad action
 Takeru-kun movement with cursor, and "wasd" key.
 And Magic staff action is "N" key, Magic axe action is "M" key.

2.Savedata in SteamCloud
 I hoped that save data was saved in Cloud.
 But this was very difficult for me long long time.

 Yesterday, suddenly I figured out how to do it.
 I tried it and it seems to be working fine.
I think I'll take a closer look.

see you next!
